definition.name: simple-integral
definition.question: How does measuring value groups turn a function into a finite weighted sum?
definition.formula: f(x)=x^2 on [0,1]; s_n(x)=2^(-n)*floor(2^n*f(x)), n=2,4; value-bin preimages have endpoints sqrt(k/2^n). The chapter's height cutoff n is inactive here.
definition.sampling: 801 exact evaluations of f; all exact bin edges and heights for the simple functions. Horizontal segments are separated at jumps; shaded rectangle boundaries are not interpolated function values. The singleton value at x=1 is marked, and endpoint choices do not affect the area.
definition.design: Two aligned panels with identical x/y ranges; warm-yellow shaded rectangles show value times preimage length, dashed neutral curve shows the same target. Widths differ because the bins divide values, not input positions.
